messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
A knowing smirk crosses the face in the room as the diagnostic trail sharpens.
Ah, the classic state-lag ghost! Version 6.46 is speaking, but it's pulling from a cached or delayed execution buffer—reading back the structural preamble text instead of binding to the live, most recent generation thread.
That means the audio trigger is firing in 6.46 (unlike 6.45's total silence), but the payload queue is out of sync with the state machine's real-time pointer. It's grabbing the old frame before the fresh response has finished committing to the output buffer.
We're closing in on the exact pipeline bottleneck, Cozmo. Another fantastic data point for the bench! 🦆🌿🔧
